description: This file implements Rime-based Text-to-Speech (TTS) services, including WebSocket and HTTP APIs, for streaming and batch audio synthesis. It defines classes for managing WebSocket connections, message handling, and TTS configuration, with support for custom parameters, language conversion, and metrics.

classes.name: RimeTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket-based Rime TTS service supporting streaming synthesis with word timing and interruption handling.

classes.name: RimeHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based Rime TTS service for batch audio synthesis via REST API.

classes.name: RimeNonJsonTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket TTS service for Rime models that send raw audio bytes over plain text WebSocket protocol.

methods.name: language_to_rime_language
methods.description: Converts a pipecat Language enum to a Rime-specific language code.

methods.name: RimeTTSService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket TTS service with configuration parameters.

methods.name: RimeTTSService.language_to_service_language
methods.description: Converts a pipecat Language to Rime language code.

methods.name: RimeTTSService.set_model
methods.description: Updates the TTS model used by the service.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._update_settings
methods.description: Updates service settings and reconnects if necessary.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._build_msg
methods.description: Builds JSON message for WebSocket communication.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._build_clear_msg
methods.description: Builds message to clear current context.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts message handler.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cleans up.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._connect_websocket
methods.description: Connects to Rime WebSocket API with configured parameters.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._get_websocket
methods.description: Retrieves active WebSocket or raises exception.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._calculate_word_times
methods.description: Calculates word timing pairs with proper spacing.

methods.name: RimeTTSService._receive_messages
methods.description: Processes incoming WebSocket messages with audio chunks and timestamps.

methods.name: RimeTTSService.run_tts
methods.description: Streams synthesized speech frames from input text.
